CustomField.description:
The line under "Willkommen zurück" in the feedback emails: the region and the travel dates, e.g. "Mallorca • 18. Juli - 25. Juli 2026". Built here rather than merged from three fields because Lightning email templates have no conditional logic and no date formatting - a booking with no region drops the bullet and shows the dates alone, so the line never renders half-empty. Month names are German by CASE, since a merge field would format the date to whichever locale sent the mail.
Deliberately does NOT use Booking__c.Name: that field is internal free text ("Test booking for invoices", and names of other customers), and is not safe to show a guest.
CustomField.formula: IF( ISPICKVAL(Region__c, ""), "", TEXT(Region__c) & IF(OR(ISBLANK(Start_Date__c), ISBLANK(End_Date__c)), "", " • ") ) & IF( OR(ISBLANK(Start_Date__c), ISBLANK(End_Date__c)), "", TEXT(DAY(Start_Date__c)) & ". " & CASE(MONTH(Start_Date__c), 1, "Januar", 2, "Februar", 3, "März", 4, "April", 5, "Mai", 6, "Juni", 7, "Juli", 8, "August", 9, "September", 10, "Oktober", 11, "November", 12, "Dezember", "") & " – " & TEXT(DAY(End_Date__c)) & ". " & CASE(MONTH(End_Date__c), 1, "Januar", 2, "Februar", 3, "März", 4, "April", 5, "Mai", 6, "Juni", 7, "Juli", 8, "August", 9, "September", 10, "Oktober", 11, "November", 12, "Dezember", "") & " " & TEXT(YEAR(End_Date__c)) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Region and dates as shown in the feedback emails. Generated automatically; do not edit.
CustomField.label: Survey Trip Summary
